title: La Bandera Dominicana
description: La Bandera Dominicana is a dish from Dominican Republic featuring white rice, chicken thigh, tomato, yellow onion. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. This is a home plate featuring rice, beans and chicken; fried plantain must be cooked before serving.

steps.instruction: Rinse the rice, add the listed water, stock, coconut milk and aromatics as specified, cover and cook gently for about 22 minutes until tender and the liquid absorbs.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 33 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 18 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 12 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
